_about: Publish-board routing (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-11: one live board, in Control Centre). live_board.url is the one live board, and every link to the board is that url at a week and a day. The engine's old board pages (the four Claude artifacts of October, then content.krishraja.com/board/<Monday>) are retired for good (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-13): every old address redirects to the live board, and what they were is recorded in docs/history/2026-11-13-old-boards-retired.md. weeks keeps the four Claude artifacts' addresses, for provenance and for the cost guard that refuses reading one whole into a chat (scripts/hooks/cost_gate.py, G5). Nothing publishes a board page; follow docs/PUBLISH_BOARDS.md.

live_board._about: The live Publish Board is Control Centre's Content tab (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-11: "your version of the publish board is 1000% where everything wires in to fresh and live and accurately"). Every link the engine gives Krish to the board is this url with ?week=<Monday>&day=<mon..sat> (scripts/post-pack/live_board.py, apps/control-plane/api/board/_liveBoard.ts, held equal by tests/control-plane/board-view-contract.test.ts), and the engine answers every old board address with a permanent redirect to it. Control Centre's rebuilt UI is its default since its cutover (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-12), so the url carries no ?ui=next.
